description: Change of use from HMO (C4 use) to a synagogue (F1 use) with ancillary offices and erection of a part single part double storey rear extension, cycle and refuse storage provision and alterations to rear fenestration
decision_conditions: <p><span id="docs-internal-guid-4868d883-7fff-b382-9831-3d9acc7295b2"></span></p><p dir="ltr" style="line-height:1.2;text-align: justify;margin-top:0pt;margin-bottom:0pt;"><span style="font-size:12pt;font-family:Arial,sans-serif;color:#000000;background-color:#ffffff;font-weight:400;font-style:normal;font-variant:normal;text-decoration:none;vertical-align:baseline;white-space:pre;white-space:pre-wrap;">The proposal would result in the loss of an existing HMO unit, which is suitable for residential use and would therefore result in the diminution of the Council's existing housing stock to the detriment of the future housing needs of the borough. As such the proposed development is contrary to Hackney Local Plan 2033 (2020) Policies LP22 (Houses in Multiple Occupation), LP24 (Preventing the Loss of Housing), London Plan (2021) Policy H8 (</span><span style="font-size:12pt;font-family:Arial,sans-serif;color:#000000;background-color:transparent;font-weight:400;font-style:normal;font-variant:normal;text-decoration:none;vertical-align:baseline;white-space:pre;white-space:pre-wrap;">Loss of existing housing and estate redevelopment), Stamford Hill Draft AAP (2024) policy AAP5 (Social, Community and Cultural Infrastructure) and</span><span style="font-size:12pt;font-family:Arial,sans-serif;color:#000000;background-color:#ffffff;font-weight:400;font-style:normal;font-variant:normal;text-decoration:none;vertical-align:baseline;white-space:pre;white-space:pre-wrap;"> the NPPF 2024</span><span style="font-size:10.5pt;font-family:Arial,sans-serif;color:#000000;background-color:#ffffff;font-weight:400;font-style:normal;font-variant:normal;text-decoration:none;vertical-align:baseline;white-space:pre;white-space:pre-wrap;">.</span></p>

<p><span id="docs-internal-guid-4a3b038e-7fff-c29c-3140-8c98aec4d467"></span></p><p dir="ltr" style="line-height:1.2;text-align: justify;margin-top:0pt;margin-bottom:0pt;"><span style="font-size:12pt;font-family:Arial,sans-serif;color:#000000;background-color:#ffffff;font-weight:400;font-style:normal;font-variant:normal;text-decoration:none;vertical-align:baseline;white-space:pre;white-space:pre-wrap;">The proposed development, by reason of it not providing high quality or inclusive design access for all, would result in sub-standard and unsuitable social and community infrastructure. The principle of development is therefore not supported and deemed contrary to London Plan (adopted 2021) Policies S1 (</span><span style="font-size:12pt;font-family:Arial,sans-serif;color:#000000;background-color:transparent;font-weight:400;font-style:normal;font-variant:normal;text-decoration:none;vertical-align:baseline;white-space:pre;white-space:pre-wrap;">Developing London’s social infrastructure)</span><span style="font-size:12pt;font-family:Arial,sans-serif;color:#000000;background-color:#ffffff;font-weight:400;font-style:normal;font-variant:normal;text-decoration:none;vertical-align:baseline;white-space:pre;white-space:pre-wrap;">, D5 (Inclusive Access) and Hackney LP33 Policies LP1 (Design Quality and Local Character) and LP8 (Social and Community Infrastructure).</span></p>

<p><span id="docs-internal-guid-d54d1917-7fff-6df5-35c0-398774ec0ad6"></span></p><p dir="ltr" style="line-height:1.2;text-align: justify;margin-top:0pt;margin-bottom:0pt;"><span style="font-size:12pt;font-family:Arial,sans-serif;color:#000000;background-color:transparent;font-weight:400;font-style:normal;font-variant:normal;text-decoration:none;vertical-align:baseline;white-space:pre;white-space:pre-wrap;">The proposed part single, part two storey rear extension, by reason of its unsympathetic scale, bulk, location and detailed design, would comprise an incongruous, discordant and overly-prominent form of development, which would detrimentally impact the character and appearance of the site and surrounding area. As such the proposed development is contrary to policy D3 (Optimising site capacity through the design-led approach) of the London Plan 2021, policy LP1 (Design Quality and Local Character) of the Hackney Local Plan 2033 and the Residential Extensions and Alterations SPD.&nbsp;</span></p>

<p><span id="docs-internal-guid-8f5e0ea0-7fff-194c-608c-f4ad6e495530"><span style="font-size: 12pt; font-family: Arial, sans-serif; background-color: transparent; font-variant-numeric: normal; font-variant-east-asian: normal; font-variant-alternates: normal; font-variant-position: normal; font-variant-emoji: normal; vertical-align: baseline; white-space-collapse: preserve;">The proposed part single, part two storey rear extension, by reason of its unsympathetic scale, bulk, location and detailed design, would result in an overbearing impact and increased sense of enclosure to the detriment of the living conditions of adjoining residential occupiers (150 and 154 Bethune Road). As such the proposed development is contrary to policy D3 (Optimising site capacity through the design-led approach) of the London Plan 2021, policy LP2 (Development and Amenity) of the Hackney Local Plan 2033 and the Residential Extensions and Alterations SPD. </span></span></p>

<p><span id="docs-internal-guid-c91ca5da-7fff-e2d3-6913-9a0c76d4298c"></span></p><p dir="ltr" style="line-height:1.2;text-align: justify;margin-top:0pt;margin-bottom:0pt;"><span style="font-size:12pt;font-family:Arial,sans-serif;color:#000000;background-color:transparent;font-weight:400;font-style:normal;font-variant:normal;text-decoration:none;vertical-align:baseline;white-space:pre;white-space:pre-wrap;">Given the absence of a legal agreement restricting staff and users of the synagogue from purchasing parking permits, the lack of a Travel Plan and adequate detail with regard to trip generation, the proposal, as submitted, would</span><span style="font-size:10.5pt;font-family:Arial,sans-serif;color:#000000;background-color:#ffffff;font-weight:400;font-style:normal;font-variant:normal;text-decoration:none;vertical-align:baseline;white-space:pre;white-space:pre-wrap;"> </span><span style="font-size:12pt;font-family:Arial,sans-serif;color:#000000;background-color:#ffffff;font-weight:400;font-style:normal;font-variant:normal;text-decoration:none;vertical-align:baseline;white-space:pre;white-space:pre-wrap;">have an adverse impact on street parking conditions, highway safety and sustainable modes of transport, contrary to Policies T1 (Strategic Approach to Transport), T4 (Assessing and Mitigating Transport Impacts) and T6 (Car Parking) of the London Plan (2021) and Hackney Local Plan Policies LP43 (</span><span style="font-size:12pt;font-family:Arial,sans-serif;color:#000000;background-color:transparent;font-weight:400;font-style:normal;font-variant:normal;text-decoration:none;vertical-align:baseline;white-space:pre;white-space:pre-wrap;">Transport and Development)</span><span style="font-size:12pt;font-family:Arial,sans-serif;color:#000000;background-color:#ffffff;font-weight:400;font-style:normal;font-variant:normal;text-decoration:none;vertical-align:baseline;white-space:pre;white-space:pre-wrap;"> and LP45 (Parking and Car Free Development).&nbsp;</span></p>

<p><span id="docs-internal-guid-f713b904-7fff-76dd-de95-0a093cb176bf"><span style="font-size: 12pt; font-family: Arial, sans-serif; font-variant-numeric: normal; font-variant-east-asian: normal; font-variant-alternates: normal; font-variant-position: normal; font-variant-emoji: normal; vertical-align: baseline; white-space-collapse: preserve;">The application fails to provide adequate information to demonstrate how the proposed development would deliver measurable Biodiversity Net Gain (BNG), contrary to the requirements set out in the Environment Act 2021. In the absence of this information, the Local Planning Authority cannot determine the impact on local biodiversity or ensure compliance with Policies LP47 (Biodiversity and Sites of Importance of Nature Conservation), LP51 (Tree Management and Landscaping) of the Hackney Local Plan 2033 (LP33), London Plan (adopted 2021) Policy G6 (Biodiversity and Access to Nature) and Paragraph 187 of the National Planning Policy Framework (NPPF).</span></span></p>
